name: Ghost Love
source:
Two paranormal detectives decide to investigate a cemetery during a blue; they were not expecting to encounter a creature beyond their understanding. There's so much pain and suffering; many spirits need their help desperately; and maybe helping them can help them understand what is truly going on in this cemetery.

[From [url=https://corrocerous.itch.io/ghostlove]itch.io[/url]]
